scope: source and hermetic provider/transaction tests; not deployed-runtime acceptance

requirements.requirement: Reuse applicable active attempts 1 and 2 despite an earlier unrelated queued suite
Refuse wrong App/workflow/attempt/suite/head/base and incomplete or synthetic evidence
Preserve required third-party failures and do not infer universal Actions applicability or optional-failure restart authority
A legitimate completed restart uses a revalidated Actions-only endpoint and has one durable request
Response or readback loss preserves membership and fences duplicate starts across restart
Definite no-write refusals can retry; budget and storage failures precede provider effects
Reuse is durable without inventing a passing verdict or acknowledgement; observations do not regress
Draft, parked, evicted and closed members do not receive post-mutation starts
